race.comment: PETIT EAGLE (3) wasn't far away fifth last time at Morphettville Parks. That followed back to back wins this trip when winding up strongly to score. Winning rider Jason Holder aboard and back in trip looks tough to stop. COLLATED (6) came from well back on cornering and hit the line strongly to score over 1600m at Murray Bridge last time out. Big win from the back and well up to this tougher assignment. MR TRAFFICANTI (10) has been in good form, scoring three back at Balaklava then placing twice in a row, most recently finishing third over 1569m at Morphettville Parks after he was well back on straightening. Has his share of ability. Hard to beat. DIVINE FIRE (11) built on a nice second two starts back at Balaklava with a win as public elect over 2050m at Strathalbyn a month ago, getting home by a head. Suitably placed so anticipating another big run. GLOUF (9) was heavily bet over the border last time and got the job done. Worth including.
